files.content:
# Harbor & Finch Case Study Facts

Customer: Harbor & Finch, home-office accessories retailer.
Challenge: preventable refund leakage and slow returns responses.
Solution: guided intake form, photo evidence, triage queue, barcode exception training.
Results: first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours; refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%; support escalations dropped 21%.
Pull quote: "The pilot gave our support leads a shared operating picture without slowing the warehouse."
CTA: Book a returns workflow audit.
